description: manni docs cite/set-up/require-citations, run in a repo that holds the page's schema/ pair, the manni.config.yaml that wires them to the reference collection, the three docs/reference/ pages and lib/limits.ts.

steps.description: Try the $ref composition the page warns about: add an allOf $ref to the vocabulary in the house schema.
The schema fails to compile when the first page it governs is validated, exit 2.

runShell.stdio: failed to compile: can't resolve reference manni:citations:1.0.0-proposal.4 from id https://example.com/reference-page.schema.json

steps.description: Back out the $ref: compose the two as a set instead.
Three pages, three outcomes: the page with no citation fails under the house schema.
The malformed entry fails under the vocabulary, the two warnings don't fail the run, and the summary matches.

runShell.stdio: /must have required property 'integrity'.*\[\.\/schema\/citations-1\.0\.0-proposal\.4\.json\][\s\S]*3 files checked, 1 passed, 2 failed, 2 errors, 2 warnings/

steps.description: claim-changed at its default is a warning: reported and green.

runShell.stdio: /↕ fetch-timeout\s+:15 changed\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 current[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 1 finding \(1 warning\)/

steps.description: Add the page's cite: severity section to manni.config.yaml.

runShell.command:
node -e "require('fs').appendFileSync('manni.config.yaml','
cite:
  severity:
    claim-changed: error
    source-moved: error
    marker-repeated: off
')"

steps.description: With claim-changed: error the same run blocks, exit 1.

runShell.stdio: /✗ fetch-timeout\s+:15 changed\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 current[\s\S]*1 file checked, 0 passed, 1 failed, 1 finding/

steps.description: A duplicate id is refused at check time, on the second entry's line.
